anatomy.propertyGroupsScopeNote: PARTIAL BY CONSTRUCTION, and populated by the calibration that measured it -- the same way primitive/layout/{flex,grid,stack,space} were populated by the spacing.rhythm packet. 'surface-decoration' is the additive gradient/keyline layer the Card root paints OVER its base fill: background-image (the --ds-card-surface-gradient <- --ds-gradient-surface tint) and the elevated variant's inset optical keyline inside box-shadow. It is deliberately NOT the base fill, the border or the radius, which belong to groups a later calibration must name when it measures them. An empty list here would have blocked every cell from IMPLEMENTED; a full invented taxonomy would have declared groups nothing has measured. EXTENDED 2026-08-23 by the shape.radius-scale calibration, exactly as this note prescribed: "surface-radius" is the Card root's CORNER — border-top-left-radius and border-bottom-right-radius, resolved through --ds-card-border-radius <- --ds-radius-lg <- calc(--ds-radius-lg-base * --ds-radius-scale). It is deliberately NOT the border STROKE (width/style) and NOT the base fill, which remain unnamed until a calibration measures them. The list is therefore still PARTIAL BY CONSTRUCTION.

themeControls.verificationNote: RE-VERIFIED UNDER B-1 (2026-08-23), light scope. The H-1 refutation recorded below is resolved for every scope this instrument can decide. B-1 gave the static transport the ingestion step the DB transport already had: the tenant floor arrives separately from the vertical baseline, the selected profile's field defaults are promoted into it, and its posture is applied after every vertical-authored writer. Measured on all six painted cases at --theme light: ingressEquivalence TRUE with ZERO differing rows, selfCheck harness-live, per-vertical source digests declared. The static arm now MOVES --ds-letter-spacing-heading on all three verticals, where H-1 measured it inert on 6/6. Both arms land on the PAIRING vocabulary (0.01em technical, 0 editorial), which the owner ruled canonical over the type axis's headingTracking; that competing writer was measured unconditionally dead and retired. The two surviving rows are BOTH dark-scope letter-spacing on bithire, and they are ledgered against OPEN_VERTICAL_CASCADE_DEFECT -- a packet of the vertical generator/cascade, not of this control. Its cause is written and measured: bithire's artifact declares the channel TWICE (src/foundation/tokens/css/facade/artifacts/bithire/index.css:644 '-0.025em' and :1496 '-0.01em' inside the higher-specificity dark block). Compounding it, the probe never applies compiled MODE BLOCKS -- the string 'modeBlocks' appears nowhere in src/tooling/resolution-probe -- so a dark-scope reading measures the shipped artifact CSS rather than the compile. The compile is correct there and was measured: with a tenant floor bithire's base emits --ds-letter-spacing-heading '0' and the dark block emits NOTHING, so dark inherits the tenant value; without one, base emits '-0.025em' and dark restates '-0.01em'. Dark is therefore measured-and-NOT-receipted (bithire-editorial.RESIDUAL-DARK-SCOPE.json), never claimed as parity.

themeControls.nextAction: OBTAIN_SIGHTED_ACCEPTANCE. Nothing further about arm equivalence is measurable by this instrument in the scopes it can decide; the dark residual belongs to OPEN_VERTICAL_CASCADE_DEFECT and is tracked there, not here.

reasons.why: REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT 2026-08-23. The previous reason - an 'Idem' chain back to "nobody reads --ds-experience-profile" - conflated the control's own PROVENANCE MARKER with its declared CHANNELS. The marker is indeed unread by card.css; two of the other four declared channels are read by it and paint. Measured: [data-part='title'] letter-spacing resolves through var(--ds-card-title-letter-spacing, var(--ds-letter-spacing-heading)) (card.css:521) and moved in 8 of 8 measured cells; [data-part='root'] background-image resolves --ds-card-elevation-surface from --ds-elevation-lift-strength (card.css:73,147) and moved in 6 of 8 - the technical stop is a true no-op for that axis in light themes, where the lift already resolves to 0.

internalChannels.note: components/card.css:133 declares it as var(--ds-letter-spacing-heading) - i.e. this socket's PRODUCER resolves it directly from experience.profile's own declared channel - and the modern skin reads it at card.css:521 with the same channel as fallback. That is why the owner is experience.profile and not typography.scale: the reader decides the owner, and both ends of this socket are this control's channel.

themeControls.propertyGroupsScopeNote: Only `surface-decoration` is declared, because it is the only group Card's own anatomy owns that covers a chain this control moves (root background-image, via --ds-elevation-lift-strength). The control's PRIMARY painted witness - [data-part='title'] letter-spacing via --ds-letter-spacing-heading - has NO anatomy-owned property group on Card: anatomy.propertyGroups is ['surface-decoration', 'surface-radius'] and neither is a type-metrics group. That chain is therefore evidenced through computedProperties and internalChannels instead of through a group. Adding a type-metrics group is an `anatomy` edit, which is a separate reviewed owner and outside this packet's authorized scope. Recorded as debt rather than worked around.

stressCases: a stop whose value computes to the property's INITIAL value (management-editorial drives letter-spacing to `normal`), which is why both measured targets carry border-top-style as a hydration witness
a vertical whose baseline already IS the selected profile (bithire x technical) - measured, DESIGNED_NULL, not receipted

reasons.why: El contenido estatico apila por orden de documento.

targetBinding.why: es la valvula de escape, no el modelo -- textual del canon: "escape hatch, not the model: every recurring override is a candidate for a real capability". Alcanza cualquier canal por construccion (allowlist cerrada, max 200, falla cerrado) y por eso no declara nada por familia.
targetBinding.instrument: un override recurrente sobre esta familia es EVIDENCIA de una capacidad faltante: convertilo en un control real, no lo normalices aqui

reasons.why: Idem: prohibido selector [data-recipe] dentro de CSS de componente; el efecto llega solo por raices rebindeadas.

targetBinding.why: no necesita raiz propia: dependsOn=[experience.profile] y sus seis ejes sobrescriben por eje los MISMOS canales que ya componen las raices existentes. Los sockets de esta celda son los sockets de las raices mapeadas, no unos nuevos.

no emite ninguna variable CSS: declaredOutputs.channels esta vacio y el propio control lo declara -- la escalera viaja como DATO (document -> schema -> artifact normalizedAppearance) y llega a la geometria solo por la puerta 2 del solver (AdaptiveLayoutEnv.spanBias) y por el bucketing de postura de contenedor. Nunca un canal CSS, nunca una lectura de viewport.
targetBinding.reach: solo las familias que consumen el runtime de adaptive-layout, y por prop de JS, no por socket
